# Pricing Model

## Purpose
The Pricing Model defines entities for flexible pricing structures, including price lists, tiered pricing, and support for recurring and one-time charges.

## Key Entities
- **PriceList**: A collection of prices for various products.
- **Price**: Base entity for pricing.
- **OneTimePrice**: A one-off charge.
- **RecurringPrice**: A charge that repeats over time.
- **Tier**: Used for volume-based or tiered pricing.
- **PricedProduct**: An entity that has an associated price.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- PriceList
    Baseclass <|-- Price
    Price <|-- OneTimePrice
    Price <|-- RecurringPrice
    Baseclass <|-- PriceListItem
    Baseclass <|-- PricingScheme
    Baseclass <|-- Tier
    Baseclass <|-- Money
    Baseclass <|-- Currency
    Baseclass <|-- PricedProduct

    PriceList "1" *-- "many" PriceListItem
    PriceListItem "many" -- "1" Price
    Price "many" -- "1" PricingScheme
    Price "many" -- "1" Money
    Money "many" -- "1" Currency
    PricingScheme "1" *-- "many" Tier
    PricedProduct "many" -- "1" PriceList

    class Price {
        +String name
        +Money money
    }
    class RecurringPrice {
        +int interval
        +IntervalUnit intervalUnit
    }
    class Money {
        +BigDecimal value
        +Currency currency
    }
    class Tier {
        +BigDecimal startingQty
        +BigDecimal endingQty
    }
```
